comparison.objective: Square a leaning stack of cartons in place without disassembling it.
comparison.physical_skill: Apply coordinated support and corrective forces to a multi-body stack.
comparison.success_condition: Stack squared without being taken apart; numeric alignment and damage thresholds are unavailable.
comparison.reason: Stack stabilization is a distributed contact-control problem, unlike localized tool impact that must fracture tangs while preserving inserts and shell.
